Under writes that do not touch the index, the earlier result stands. Also: the default parallelism is kept for PK-only tables, a client timeout does not stop the server statement, the ENUM guard, replica STOP failure and channel gate are measured, type results now cover all 5 versions, and the catalog is re-based on the re-run of script 10. FIND-O10-INDEXED-100-STALL: an unexplained 66.8 s split and a whole-run write p95 of 1646.57 ms at 100 writes/s are missing from the text. latestAccuracySteering.conditionMechanisms: Distinguish effects on statistical accuracy, cost under a fixed budget, and freshness. Key-space sparsity/cell-density variance affect sampling interval convergence; page-level row-size/density heterogeneity, stats sample pages and staleness affect metadata error. A small index, cache, TDE, row width and MVCC mainly change read/CPU/time cost and therefore attainable precision within a fixed budget; they do not make a completed snapshotCOUNT approximate. Concurrent writes/replica lag can change the represented time/population and must not be conflated with estimator error. More sample pages/ANALYZE does not guarantee monotonic accuracy and has separate maintenance impact.
